title: The Monsoon of the Coral Triangle
author: Noor Thornbury
blurb: Theo Zhou, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
